entries.original: [Tong-Nou] requires a VGA card capable of displaying 256 colors (8-bit color) at a minimum resolution of 640 by 480 pixels.
entries.translation: [Tong-Nou] requiere una tarjeta VGA capaz de mostrar 256 colores (colores 8-bit) en una mínima resolución de 640 por 480 pixeles.

entries.original: [Quick Time] has not been installed. [Quick Time](v2.0) is recommended and included on the disk. You can install it by launching the QuickTime installation program.
entries.translation: [Quick Time] no está instalado. Se recomienda [Quick Time](v2.0) el cual viene incluído en este disco. Lo puede instalar ejecutando el instalador de QuickTime.
